The season began on 18 July 2014 and was scheduled to end in May 2015. Ten teams competed throughout the entire season. ==Teams== [[Rio Abajo F.C.|Rio Abajo]] finished in 10th place in the overall table last season and were relegated to the [[Liga Nacional de Ascenso]].
